title: Builders Paintings
description: This pack is a painting pack to replace all Minecraft paintings with some beautiful Minecraft builds I have found from the community. The builds are all of a similar style for cohesiveness and because I enjoy the style.
body:
This pack is a painting pack to replace all Minecraft paintings with some beautiful Minecraft builds I have found from the community. The builds are all of a similar style for cohesiveness and because I enjoy the style.
The builders included in this are:
